Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.database

Class FriendService

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.database.FriendService
public class FriendService extends Object
Provides friendship-related Firestore operations. Friendships are stored as a friends subcollection under each user document. Adding a friend writes both sides atomically via a WriteBatch.

    • addFriend

      public void addFriend(User currentUser, User target, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Writes a mutual friendship atomically: adds target to currentUser's friends list and currentUser to target's friends list.
      Parameters:
      currentUser - The signed-in user initiating the add.
      target - The user being added as a friend.
      onSuccess - Called when both writes commit successfully.
      onFailure - Called with an error message if the batch fails.

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenFriends(String uid, Consumer<List<FriendEntry>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)

      A ListenerRegistration — call .remove() in onDestroyView().
